title: Things I wish someone told me on day one: the body is open to close, the wicks are the extremes. What was your ‘oh, that’s it?’ moment?”
author: Witty_Reaction_9843
selftext: been a hot minute... finals are coming up in the next 2 weeks and it's been really hard staying on track in my trading learning journey while juggling 3 finals. anyway, today i learnt how to read and infer candles and wow, because i had never understood these figures when looking at charts in the past

comments.author: AoideusWasBanned
comments.body:
Good luck with the finals first 😁

Mine came a bit later: a candle doesn't tell you the order. The high can come before the low or after it. Learned that when a backtest hit both my stop and my target inside the same candle and I had no idea which one actually happened.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: wicks took me longer than bodies. a long wick only means much at a level people were already watching, the same candle in the middle of a range is mostly noise. which timeframe are you learning on?
